title: A sort of a backlog names its base commit, and a check refuses to act on it when main moved past that base
why: Triage 11 acted on the outbox sort of Nov 17 (base b58eb9848) as if K 480 notes were still missing at 11:38 CST Nov 18. A PR filing 419 K notes merged at 01:18 CST Nov 18, so six agents re-checked and found 70 missing.
source: triage 11, 11:50 CST Nov 18, from the six record-writer reports
note: Not built. Prior work: searched steps and lint for a base-freshness check on a sort; none found (read 11:58 CST). Done when: a brief that acts on a sort or audit file refuses when the file's base commit is not an ancestor-or-equal check against main's tip for the paths it names, or names the paths that changed since the base. Mover: the coordinator's say-so.
